value.title: Backpressure survey — Plan 028 prep canonical tables

value.criterion: ac-0001 incremental/idempotent/atomic: unchanged re-run reads 0 body bytes, append reads only after the cursor, replace/truncate/rewrite start a new generation, crash leaves the previous publication intact.
value.proof: BUILD→RUN: engine tests with RecordingFold + MemoryPrepStore (injected commit failure) and store tests with injected failures between parts and state; then `cargo test --locked -p unisphere-sdk --test prep` and `cargo test --locked -p unisphere-output-prep --test store`. EXTEND→RUN: add a `prep` mode to unisphere-proof; then `cargo run --locked -p unisphere-testkit --bin unisphere-proof -- prep`.
value.probe: POC has 4 fold unit tests only (crates/adapter-claude/src/prep.rs mod tests) and no sdk/store/loader prep tests; its copy-based proofs live outside Git (main scratch/poc-prep-duckdb/proofs.py); unisphere-proof modes stop at git-notes (crates/testkit/src/bin/unisphere-proof.rs:603-611).

value.criterion: ac-0002 live files never fail: concurrent non-LF-aligned writer, partial tail reported and picked up next run; real live fleet.
value.proof: BUILD→RUN: concurrent random-chunk writer test in `cargo test --locked -p unisphere-sdk --test prep`. EXTEND→RUN: port the POC live_proof.py to the v2 schema as docs/plans/028-prep-canonical-tables/assets/proof/live.py (scratch-only output); then `python3 docs/plans/028-prep-canonical-tables/assets/proof/live.py --scratch .harness/temp/prep-real`.
value.probe: POC live_proof.py ran 22 randomized runs with 0 failures (main scratch/poc-prep-duckdb/live_proof.py, live-proof-output.json); not in Git, not wired to any lane.

value.criterion: ac-0003 CLI/SDK parity: prep composed from public ports; external SDK consumer runs incremental prep with its own store; core/SDK ports free of Parquet/SQLite/engines; catalogue reports persisted resume for covered harnesses.
value.proof: EXTEND→RUN: arch-check allowlist (already denies unapproved edges) + a prep external-consumer fixture beside crates/testkit/fixtures/consumer and installed-CLI comparison in the new proof mode; then `cargo run --locked -p unisphere-testkit --bin unisphere-arch-check` and `cargo run --locked -p unisphere-testkit --bin unisphere-proof -- prep`; catalogue flag asserted in crates/app/tests/adapter_catalog.rs via `cargo test --locked -p unisphere-app --test adapter_catalog`.
value.probe: Arch allowlist crates/testkit/src/bin/unisphere-arch-check.rs:14-117 (core: serde/serde_json/sha2/time; sdk adds regex/globset); consumer fixture pattern unisphere-proof.rs:180-273; catalogue test crates/app/tests/adapter_catalog.rs:119 asserts cli_persisted_resume false today.

value.criterion: ac-0004 Claude cost correctness: dedupe (message.id, requestId) per-field max, 1h/5m split with fallback, <synthetic> as limit events; file-F, four window totals and every call row equal the reference parser or divergences are reviewer-accepted.
value.proof: BUILD→RUN: fold rule tests on synthetic fixtures; then `cargo test --locked -p unisphere-adapter-claude --test prep`. EXTEND→RUN: port the POC parity.py to the v2 tables (source key, calls_v) as docs/plans/028-prep-canonical-tables/assets/proof/parity.py driving a scratch copy of extract.py; then `python3 docs/plans/028-prep-canonical-tables/assets/proof/parity.py --scratch .harness/temp/prep-real`. Divergence acceptance is reviewer judgement.
value.probe: POC parity.py matched 55,607 calls on five counters, model, call_in_turn, trigger, sender (main scratch/poc-prep-duckdb/parity-output.txt); reference extract.py at ~/games/unasphere/scratch/unisphere-feedback (writes content CSVs; copy outside Git).

value.criterion: ac-0005 typed facts: compaction, recap, scheduled fires, limit notices with parsed reset instants, queue ops, model switches; turn origin; sidechain parent link; tool_uses table.
value.proof: BUILD→RUN: fold tests per event kind, origin precedence and tool-use/result pairing on synthetic fixtures; then `cargo test --locked -p unisphere-adapter-claude --test prep`.
value.probe: No tool_uses table or parsed resets in the POC (FINDINGS gaps); no prep fixtures exist in crates/adapter-claude/tests.

value.criterion: ac-0006 every registered harness in the same table contract, representation-appropriate change detection, explicit nulls with coverage.
value.proof: BUILD→RUN (guide v2): per-harness fold tests on synthetic fixtures derived from the existing query fixtures, snapshot loader tests incl. SQLite WAL growth, proof-mode extension; then `cargo test --locked -p <adapter or loader-snapshot> --test prep` per lane and `cargo run --locked -p unisphere-testkit --bin unisphere-proof -- prep`.
value.probe: Synthetic native fixtures exist per adapter (crates/adapter-{omp,pi,copilot-cli,vscode-copilot}/tests/fixtures, adapter-codex/fixtures, adapter-cursor/fixtures); SQLite loader tests crates/loader-snapshot/tests/sqlite.rs; no prep folds outside Claude.

value.criterion: ac-0007 honest coverage: per-source outcome vocabulary, skipped symlink/hidden counts, explicit extra roots.
value.proof: BUILD→RUN: loader discovery tests on temp trees with symlinks and hidden entries, engine status tests, CLI render tests; then `cargo test --locked -p unisphere-loader-jsonl --test prep`, `cargo test --locked -p unisphere-sdk --test prep`, `cargo test --locked -p unisphere-cli --test prep`.
value.probe: POC discover silently skips symlinks/hidden (crates/loader-jsonl/src/prep.rs:31-45) and FINDINGS records one excluded source from it.

value.criterion: ac-0008 versioned documented table contract; external engine reads Parquet without per-engine schema; compaction preserves every view result.
value.proof: BUILD→RUN: store tests reading Parquet back (parquet Arrow reader + arrow-json) and applying the canonical-view rules before/after compaction; then `cargo test --locked -p unisphere-output-prep --test store`. External-engine read of views.sql: `python3 docs/plans/028-prep-canonical-tables/assets/proof/recipes_check.py --scratch .harness/temp/prep-real` (phase 2; needs DuckDB).
value.probe: POC never compacts (FINDINGS: policy bump grew storage); no output-prep tests directory exists.

value.criterion: ac-0009 named research recipes through one documented command against external DuckDB; clear error without an engine; no engine linked.
value.proof: BUILD→RUN (guide v2): recipe catalogue tests; then `cargo test --locked -p unisphere-cli --test recipes`; external run `python3 docs/plans/028-prep-canonical-tables/assets/proof/recipes_check.py --scratch .harness/temp/prep-real`. Requires an operator-approved DuckDB CLI install.
value.probe: `which duckdb` → not found (2026-09-29); Python duckdb 1.5.3 importable; POC prep_sql.py ran 30/30 recipes on DuckDB (main scratch/poc-prep-duckdb/recipes-output-duckdb.txt).

value.criterion: ac-000a native address per expensive row; exact record fetch with explicit content opt-in without re-reading the transcript.
value.proof: BUILD→RUN: record_at loader tests, engine record tests (refusal without opt-in before any read), CLI record tests, proof-mode fetch; then `cargo test --locked -p unisphere-loader-jsonl --test prep`, `cargo test --locked -p unisphere-sdk --test prep`, `cargo run --locked -p unisphere-testkit --bin unisphere-proof -- prep`.
value.probe: POC rows carry native_offset but no fetch path exists.

value.criterion: ac-000b privacy and safety: metadata-only default, content columns absent unless opted in, native stores read-only and never locked/renamed/written, no real content in tests or fixtures.
value.proof: BUILD→RUN: content-gating fold tests, CLI opt-in refusal tests, loader read-only open tests; then `cargo test --locked -p unisphere-adapter-claude --test prep` and `cargo test --locked -p unisphere-cli --test prep`; fixture/evidence content review is reviewer judgement.
value.probe: Installed-CLI proof already checks privacy-marker suppression for existing verbs (unisphere-proof.rs:481-579); nothing covers prep.

value.criterion: ac-000c fleet-scale measurement: cold, warm unchanged and append runs with peak RSS and bytes read vs the POC baseline; bounded memory.
value.proof: EXTEND→RUN: port the POC run-all timing captures (/usr/bin/time -l) into docs/plans/028-prep-canonical-tables/assets/proof/measure.py; then `python3 docs/plans/028-prep-canonical-tables/assets/proof/measure.py --scratch .harness/temp/prep-real` (Claude in phase 1, all harnesses in phase 2).
value.probe: POC timings: main scratch/poc-prep-duckdb/run-*-{cold,warm}.time (3.46 s cold full, 0.05–0.62 s unchanged, ~0.5 GB RSS).

value.criterion: ac-000d offline docs: prep and research-recipes topics with tested examples, table contract, incremental/generation semantics, privacy defaults.
